ModMetaData.name: DMS Apparel Compatibility Patch
ModMetaData.author: ShadowSTARS616
ModMetaData.description:
让原版斥候甲和更多mod服装（动力甲）能够使用失能机关需要特定体型装备的武器。可能会有点不平衡（过强）Enables vanilla recon armor and more modded apparel (power armor) to use weapons that require a specific body type for DMS. 如果你不安装下列其他mod，则仅添加原版斥候甲的支持。If the following additional mods are not installed, only vanilla recon armor support is added.
目前支持/supported mods： [OA]Ratkin Faction: Oberonia aurea [1.6] Moyo - from the depth Kiiro Race Combat extended
已新增支持/Added support for ： （这边的mod我玩得比较少或者根本不玩，如果出现遗漏或者错误，请告诉我以便进行修复/I don't play these mods much or at all, so if anything is missing or wrong, please let me know so I can fix it） Vanilla Armour Expanded Ratkin Weapons+ [1.6] Moyo - The Cartel Arrives Miho, the celestial fox Moyo2.0-Blood stained business Milira Race MoeLotl Race Wolfein Race 联合重工-UF Heavy Industries 联合重工-龙骑兵拓展 UFHI-MobileDragoon Ratkin clothes维多利亚的港湾 Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates WarCasket Expanded Milira:Wings of Democracy V1.0 Milira Faction: Milira Imperium [RH2] Faction: Utilitarian Dead Space Equipment Altered Carbon 2: ReSleeved CeleTech Arsenal MKIII Rabbie The Moonrabbit race Epona Dynastic Rise
